caseName: Graham ex rel. Estate of Graham v. Teledyne-Continental Motors
caseNameFull: Graham, as of the Estate of Graham v. Teledyne-Continental Motors, a Division of Teledyne Industries, Inc.

opinions.text:
C. A. 9th Cir. Application for recall and stay of mandate and injunction, addressed to The Chief Justice and referred to the Court, denied.

Justice Brennan and Justice Stevens would grant the application.
